newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boatmen's Bancshares cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boatmen's Bancshares cut.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said it cut its rating on Boatmen's Bancshares Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for comment.
-- Analyst Dennis Shea later said that he cut his rating on the stock as a result of a 24 percent rally on Friday, which was sparked by the announcement of a merger agreement with NationsBank Corp.
"When a stock makes a move that big, I'm going to cut the rating. It doesn't make sense to stay with it," he said.
